## Outcome

Produce one immutable release-tail admission record for the converged milestone candidate.

## Primary deliverable

One immutable release-tail admission record indexing every reviewed-green ancestral execution root.

## Verification result

The admission validator reports the exact root denominator, revisions, artifacts, ancestry, and zero unresolved collisions.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one admission decision; lane receipts are evidence inputs and lane remediation remains separately owned.

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every lane is reviewed merged and ancestral
- [ ] Exact revisions and artifacts are indexed
- [ ] Cross-lane collisions are resolved by owners

## Owned paths

- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/integration/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/DEMO_MATRIX_v0.92.1.md`

## PVF lanes

- `merged-authority-census`
- `ancestry`
- `artifact-index`
- `collision-check`

## Stop conditions

- Any lane lacks reviewed merged authority
- Evidence revisions disagree

## Non-goals

- Implementing child fixes
- Release approval
